propDocs.Popover.modal: False leaves outside content usable; true traps focus and locks scroll; trap-focus traps focus while leaving outside content usable.
propDocs.Popover.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
propDocs.Popover.dismissible: Allows Escape and outside interactions to close the popup.
propDocs.Popover.openOnHover: Opens after resting on the trigger, while retaining press activation.
propDocs.PopoverTrigger.disabled: Prevents the trigger from opening the popup.
propDocs.PopoverTrigger.focusableWhenDisabled: Keeps a disabled trigger in the tab order.
propDocs.PopoverContent.side: Preferred side, subject to collision handling.
propDocs.PopoverContent.align: Alignment with the trigger along that side.
propDocs.PopoverContent.sideOffset: Gap between trigger and popup in pixels.
propDocs.PopoverContent.keepMounted: Keeps closed content in the document, hidden.
propDocs.PopoverClose.variant: Default raised key or primary action styling.
